defaultValue.title: BorealisPlaylistsServ.getPlaylistAccess(playlistId, userId)
defaultValue.description: Helper to check access levels (Owner, Editor, Viewer) for a custom playlist.

steps.title: Database `first` on `CustomList` and stores it as `playlist`
Define `isOwner`, `collab`, `role`, `canEdit`, `canView`
steps.payload:
const isOwner = playlist.userId === userId
const collab = (playlist.collaborators as any[])?.find((c: any) => c.userId === userId)
const role: 'OWNER' | 'EDITOR' | 'VIEWER' | null = isOwner ? 'OWNER' : collab ? (collab.role as 'EDITOR' | 'VIEWER') : null
const canEdit = isOwner || role === 'EDITOR'
const canView = isOwner || !!role || !playlist.isPrivate
